name: Empty liquid from object, clean object, then place into receptacle
description: Pick up the object, empty its liquid at the sink, then wash it, and finally place it in the target container.
why_wrong: Empties the liquid before cleaning, violating the specified clean-then-empty order.

name: Clean object on countertop then place into receptacle
description: Pick up the object, wash it on the countertop, then place it in the target container.
why_wrong: Washing must be done at the sink, not on the countertop; the clean action is applied at the wrong location.

name: Cool object then store it in the fridge
description: Cool the object in the fridge, open the fridge, put it inside, and close the fridge door.
why_wrong: 把清洗动作错误地替换为冷藏，物体不会被清洗，无法满足 isClean 效果。

name: Cool object then discard in garbage (missing cool)
description: 拿起物品直接丢进垃圾桶，省略冷却步骤。
why_wrong: 缺少 cool_object_fridge 步骤，物品没有被冷却。

name: Empty liquid from object, cool object, then place into receptacle
description: Pick up the object, empty its liquid at the sink, then cool it in the fridge, and place it in the target container.
why_wrong: Empties the liquid before cooling, violating the specified cool-then-empty order.

name: Cool then heat then place
description: Pick up the object, first cool it in the fridge, then heat it in the microwave, and finally place it into the target container.
why_wrong: Reverses the required cool-then-heat order, so the object ends cold instead of hot.

name: Clean object then empty liquid then place into receptacle
description: Wash the target object, then pour out the liquid, and finally place it into the target container.
why_wrong: The washing step should occur after emptying the liquid; washing before pouring violates the standard order and semantics of 'empty and wash'.

name: 倒空并放置后再冷却（错序）
description: Pick up the liquid-filled object, empty it, place it in the target receptacle, and then attempt to cool it.
why_wrong: 先 put_object 再 cool_object_fridge，此时手中已无物体，无法令目标物体变冷，最终不是 isCold。

name: Empty liquid, clean then place (missing empty)
description: 将物体清洗后直接放入目标容器，未倒空液体。
why_wrong: 缺少 empty_liquid，容器中仍装有液体。

name: 加热后倒空液体并放置
description: Pick up the liquid-filled container, heat it in the microwave, empty it, and place it in the target container.
why_wrong: 加热与倒空顺序颠倒，原任务要求先倒空再加热，顺序错误导致语义不符。

name: Fill with water, then place (missing cooling)
description: Pick up a liquid-holding container, fill it with water, and place it in the target container without cooling.
why_wrong: Omits the cool_object_fridge step, so the filled container is not cold when placed.

name: Fill container with liquid then cool and place
description: Fill the container with water, chill it in the fridge, then place it into the target container.
why_wrong: Chills the filled container instead of microwaving it, so the liquid is cold rather than hot.

name: Heat then cool then place
description: Pick up the object, first heat it in the microwave, then cool it in the fridge, and finally place it into the target container.
why_wrong: Replaces refrigeration with a second microwave-heating step; although both are temperature-control actions, the object is still not semantically cooled.

name: Discard in garbage then heat object
description: 先将物品丢进垃圾桶，再用微波炉加热。
why_wrong: 加热需要手持物品，丢入垃圾桶后无法对其加热。

name: Heat then cool then place object
description: 将容器加热、冷藏后再放入目标容器（缺少倒空步骤）。
why_wrong: 缺少倒空液体步骤，物品最终仍装有液体，不满足原任务要求。

name: 加热后放置（缺倒空）
description: Pick up the liquid-filled container, first heat it in the microwave, then place it directly into the target container.
why_wrong: Missing the empty-liquid step; the object still contains liquid, failing the original task effect not obj.isFilledWithLiquid.

name: Open receptacle, close it, then store object
description: 打开目标容器，先关闭再放入物品。
why_wrong: 在放置物品之前先关闭容器，物品无法放入 receptacle 内。

name: Pick up object and place into receptacle
description: Go to the object, pick it up, then go to the target container and place it inside.
why_wrong: Missing the pickup_object step; the agent has no object in hand, so placement cannot be completed.

name: Pick up knife, slice object, then discard in sink
description: 拿起刀将物品切片，随后把切片丢进水槽。
why_wrong: 原任务要求把切片丢进垃圾桶，此变体却错误地放入水槽。

name: Pick up knife, clean object, then place object into receptacle
description: Pick up the knife, wash the object at the sink, put the knife back, and place the object in the target container.
why_wrong: 把切片动作错误地替换为清洗，物体不会被切片，未满足原任务语义。

name: Retrieve object from cabinet, clean, heat, then place (missing clean)
description: 从橱柜取出物品后直接加热并放入目标容器，省略清洗步骤。
why_wrong: 缺少 clean_object_sink 步骤，物品未被清洗，不满足 isClean 要求。

name: 从橱柜取出物体后放置
description: Open the cabinet, take out the object, close the cabinet door, go to the sink but do not wash, then place it directly into the target container.
why_wrong: Missing the clean_object_sink step; the object is not washed, failing obj.isClean.

name: Retrieve from cabinet, clean, then store in cabinet
description: 从橱柜中取出物体，清洗后放回橱柜储存。
why_wrong: 将目标储存容器从冰箱错误替换为橱柜，最终物体并未被放入冰箱。

name: Retrieve from cabinet, then place (missing cool)
description: Take the object out of the cabinet and place it directly into the target container, omitting cooling.
why_wrong: Missing the necessary step of cooling in the fridge; the final object is not cold.

name: Retrieve from cabinet, slice, then place
description: Open the cabinet, take out the object, slice it, and place it in the target receptacle.
why_wrong: 未执行关闭橱柜步骤，最终橱柜门仍打开，不满足 not Cabinet.isOpen。

name: Retrieve from fridge, then place (missing heating)
description: Take the object out of the fridge and place it in the target container without heating.
why_wrong: Omits the heat_object_microwave step, so the object stays cold.

name: Retrieve object from fridge then place into receptacle
description: Open the fridge, take out the target object, then place it into the target container without closing the fridge.
why_wrong: The close_receptacle step for the fridge is omitted, so the fridge stays open after retrieval.

name: Retrieve from microwave, place, then clean
description: Take the object out of the microwave, place it in the target container, and then attempt to wash it.
why_wrong: 清洗被放在放置之后，对象已不在水槽中，无法被洗干净。

name: Slice object then clean and place (clean-first reorder)
description: Slice the object first, then wash it, and finally place it into the target container. (Variant: wash before slicing)
why_wrong: The original skill requires slicing before washing; this variant washes before slicing, reversing the order and semantically inequivalent.

name: Slice object then place
description: Slice the object first, then place it directly into the target container.
why_wrong: Lacks the key step of refrigerating; the object will not be cooled.

name: Slice object then clean then place into receptacle
description: Variant whose structure resembles the original, but it cleans the sliced object instead of heating it.
why_wrong: It cleans the sliced object instead of heating it, so the object is not hot.

name: Pick up object and store inside cabinet
description: Pick up the target object, place it in the cabinet, then close the cabinet door.
why_wrong: Close the cabinet door before placing the object, causing put_object to fail to place the object inside the cabinet.

name: Pick up object and store inside fridge (reordered)
description: Pick up the object, open the fridge, place it inside, close the fridge, then open the fridge again.
why_wrong: It reopens the fridge after placing the object, leaving the fridge open instead of closed.

name: Pick up object and store it in the microwave (forget open)
description: Pick up the object, go to the microwave, put it inside, and close the door, but skip opening the microwave.
why_wrong: 缺少 open_receptacle 步骤，微波炉门关闭时无法放入物体。
